The array of science YouTubers in the image is paying homage to a notable Irish physicist, whose character later raps "And no one uses my quaternions, But just you wait, just you wait". **What's his name, man?**

questions.clueing:
At a glance, the lines below are gibberish; but in a different sense they're quite familiar. Describe **WHAT are lost**...

> Lille' beau pipe
> Ocelot serre chypre
> En *douzaine* aux verres tuf indemne
> Livre de melons un dé huile qu'aux mômes
> Eau à guigne d'air telle baie indemne
questions.hint: the progenitors in "Viable offspring derived from fetal and adult mammalian cells" (Wilmut, Schnieke et al., Nature 1997 Feb 27;385(6619):810-3)
questions.label: gibberish

questions.clueing: "千里之行，始于足下". Ha! 老子 had a Lǐ hardly 438 yards long, what's he know? Me, I'm an inchworm, and one quarter-inch step each second feels 老 slow. Oh, 足下, my 足 sure ache — **would you tell me how long this whole journey will take**?
questions.hint: titlewise, Richard Henry Dana Jr's period in the fo'c's'le (the equivalent of fifty-six RFK crises plus two Ivan Denisoviches, or 10% of a Jane Addams' Hull-House)
questions.label: inchworm

> They class them as cold-blooded fugitives,
> They say they are heartless and mean,
> But I say this with pride:
> That I once knew [REDACTED]
> When he was honest and upright and clean
